Automatically decode rescue-service keyw: Automatically decode rescue-service keywords (R<RTW>N<NEF>[p][f][-NT], with or without spaces)
Base URL of the WAIP dispatch server (So: Base URL of the WAIP dispatch server (Socket.IO endpoint, namespace /waip is appended automatically)
Color of the marker dot, or of the polyg: Color of the marker dot, or of the polygon outline when one is drawn (see 'Show incident-area polygon').
For every incident with valid coordinate: For every incident with valid coordinates, downloads OpenStreetMap tiles and composes a PNG centered on the incident's location, with the incident area WAIP-Web sends drawn as an outline (falls back to a marker dot if no area polygon is available). The file path is written to the einsatz.kartenbildPfad state, e.g. for sending as a Pushover attachment from a Blockly/JavaScript script. Only the 10 most recent images are kept, older ones are deleted automatically. Uses the public tile.openstreetmap.org server - keep this to the intended one-image-per-incident use per the OSM Tile Usage Policy.
Generate a map image for each incident: Generate a map image for each incident
Height of the generated map image in pix: Height of the generated map image in pixels (applies to both the marker dot and the polygon outline).
How long to wait for the server to confi: How long to wait for the server to confirm the monitor registration before logging a warning; the connection itself keeps running either way.
How many of the most recent matching inc: How many of the most recent matching incidents to show (dashboard.einsatz1..einsatzN). Higher values create proportionally more states/channels.
How often the dashboard is refreshed. A: How often the dashboard is refreshed. A full refresh connects to the server once per slot in sequence, so it realistically takes several seconds per active slot - the minimum here reflects that.
Label for suffix -NT / nt (special ambul: Label for suffix -NT / nt (special ambulance transport)
Line thickness of the incident-area outl: Line thickness of the incident-area outline, in pixels.
Loaded live from the configured server's: Loaded live from the configured server's /waip/ overview page - choose by Leitstelle, Kreis, Träger or Wache, or pick 'Alle Wachalarme' (ID 0) for every incident. If the server can't be reached, an ID can still be entered manually.
Maps einsatz.stichwort to einsatz.beschr: Maps einsatz.stichwort to einsatz.beschreibung. Comparison is case-insensitive and treats spaces/hyphens as equivalent (any run of either collapses to one before comparing), so e.g. "H:VU mit P" and "H:VU-mit-P" match the same row - no need for a separate row per spelling. If several rows match, the most specific (longest) pattern wins automatically - row order has no effect on matching, sort by any column freely. Pre-filled with an example fire/rescue keyword list as a starting point - it is not confirmed to match your own dispatch center's actual keywords, edit/replace as needed. To back up or transfer this table, use ioBroker's standard instance configuration export/import (JSON). After using that import, reload the Admin page before checking this table - the open config dialog doesn't refresh it from an external import automatically (a state-sync limitation of the Admin table component itself).
Map images are derived from this adapter: Map images are derived from this adapter's own incident-map history (see 'Incident map image' tab) and are only available where it already generated one for a matching incident - most complete when Monitor ID is 0 and map images are enabled. A manual refresh can be triggered any time via the dashboard.refreshNow button state.
Maximum time to wait for the map image (: Maximum time to wait for the map image (OSM tile download and composition) to finish before continuing to process the incident. If it isn't ready within this time, a warning is logged and einsatz.kartenbildPfad stays empty for this incident.
OpenStreetMap zoom level (1 = whole worl: OpenStreetMap zoom level (1 = whole world, 19 = building level). Fixed zoom for the marker dot; a maximum for the polygon outline, auto-reduced if needed to keep it fully visible (see 'Show incident-area polygon').
Rescue-service keyword scheme R<RTW>N<NE: Rescue-service keyword scheme R<RTW>N<NEF>, optionally followed by a p/f modifier and/or an NT suffix (e.g. "R1N0" = 1 ambulance, no emergency physician). Two spellings are recognized: without a space and with a hyphen before NT (Leitstelle Lausitz, e.g. "R1N1p", "R1N0-NT") and with a space and without a hyphen (Leitstelle Brandenburg/IRLS, e.g. "R1N1 p", "R1N0 nt") - has no effect if your dispatch center doesn't use one of these patterns, since the keyword just won't match. Takes priority over the table on the Keyword descriptions tab when a keyword matches.
Shows the last N incidents (N = number b: Shows the last N incidents (N = number below) matching this instance's Monitor ID (Connection tab) as dashboard.einsatz1..einsatzN, correlated via the incident's dispatch center/district/carrier/station IDs, same matching logic as the Monitor ID dropdown itself. Monitor ID 0 (all dispatch monitors) shows all incidents. Disabling the feature removes the entire dashboard object tree; reducing the count below removes only the now-unused slots. Both take effect on the next adapter restart after saving.
Text appended when the keyword ends in \: Text appended when the keyword ends in "-NT" or " nt".
Text appended when the keyword ends in "f".
Text appended when the keyword ends in "p".
Text used in the generated description f: Text used in the generated description for the N<n> part, e.g. "Notfalleinsatzfahrzeug: 0".
Text used in the generated description for the R<n> part, e.g. "Rettungswagen: 1".
Wait time before the adapter automatical: Wait time before the adapter automatically reconnects after a lost connection or a connection error.
When checked (default), the incident-are: When checked (default), the incident-area polygon WAIP-Web sends is drawn as an outline (falling back to a centered marker dot only when no polygon is available). Uncheck to always show the simple centered marker dot instead, even when a polygon is available.
When unchecked, incidents whose einsatza: When unchecked, incidents whose einsatzart identifies them as a rescue-service call (contains "Rettung" or "Krankentransport", case-insensitive) are ignored completely - no states are updated, no history entry is written, no TTS announcement is triggered. Useful because some WAIP dispatch centers only ever signal rescue-service incidents unreliably or not at all.
Width of the generated map image in pixe: Width of the generated map image in pixels (applies to both the marker dot and the polygon outline).
